notes.title: Uptade 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello,

Final game update (so far), bugs fixed.

notes.title: Thank you for everything!
notes.notes:
Hello,

 I would like to thank everyone who supported and bought Sarissa and the Legendary Sword, thanks to your support I was able to have the joy of having my first game not only released, but also experienced by people on Steam. Originally the game would already be released as if it were a complete version, but for my desire that it has original art, I decided to put it in early access, hope to be able to reach a goal that allows me to invest in it. Unfortunately, that goal hasn't been reached and I don't see it being in the near future, so I'll be ending the game's early access at this point. For those who bought the game or are going to buy it, don't worry, as the early access message itself says, the game is complete from start to finish, including one of the access goals was achieved and a post-game was added and bug fixes. bugs were made. I don't say for sure that an update in the future adding original art is impossible, but at the moment I see that the best thing to do is focus on my next project since at least I can know that I delivered a "complete" game in its story and gameplay. This also does not mean the end of the story of Sarissa and her friends, I intend in the future to bring more of this story as soon as possible. The next game update should be the last one, and apart from that, the only other news I have is that it should soon receive a smartphone port. Thanks again for everyone's support, I hope you're here to enjoy my next game too. Peace to all and see you soon.
